title: Effect of Topical Tetracycline and Dexamethasone on Periodontal and Pulpal Regeneration of Replanted Avulsed Teeth
brief_summary: To evaluate the effect of topical tetracycline and dexamethasone on periodontal and pulpal regeneration of avulsed permanent teeth after an observation period between 9-16 years.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Avulsion of a permanent tooth
* Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Extended dry period of more than 60 minutes
study_population: Patients with avulsed permanent teeth who were treated between 2000-2008 at the Department of Oral Surgery, zmk Bern
